observations: Current DE dm.de GTIN 071164341469 is a 473 ml product and is not merged with older 355 ml Argan Oil listings.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: The exact formula/positioning are resolved for this shadow audit, but the product does not deliberately target dry, tight, itchy, flaky or sensitive scalp comfort with a coherent specialist route. This means no specialist scalp-comfort target, not that the product is unsuitable for every sensitive user.

supportingSignals.observation: The exact formula/positioning are sufficient for this shadow audit, but no exact-product evidence establishes a dedicated dry, tight, itchy, flaky or sensitive scalp-comfort target with a coherent specialist route.
supportingSignals.inference: The direct product property is not_targeted. This does not mean the product is unsuitable for every sensitive user.

counterSignals.observation: Generic gentle, dermatological, anti-dandruff, oil-control, hair-care, volume, shine or repair positioning is not by itself a scalp-comfort target under the approved gates.
counterSignals.inference: Sensitive-profile suitability is derived separately from cleansing strength, scalp oiliness, dandruff support and exposure preferences.

dandruffSupport.rationale: The repair formula contains no captured anti-dandruff active, dandruff positioning or endpoint; strong cleansing alone is not a dandruff-support route.

supportingSignals.observation: The evidence is repair and conditioning focused, with no dandruff-specific active or claim.
supportingSignals.inference: The product should not be selected for dandruff support.

counterSignals.observation: Strong cleansing can remove surface oil and loose scale.
counterSignals.inference: This nonspecific effect does not establish dandruff suitability.

cleansing.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Olefin sulfonate plus MIPA/CAPB/Decyl Glucoside is strong cleanser architecture.

conditioningDeposition.g1FunctionalRelevance: Damaged/frizzy feel can improve through lubrication/deposition.
conditioningDeposition.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Argan oil, polyquats, glycol distearate, dicaprylyl ether and glyceryl oleate form coherent conditioning.

weightBuildup.g1FunctionalRelevance: Emollients and polymers can leave residue.
weightBuildup.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Multiple depositors are present but no silicone/butter-rich system.
weightBuildup.g3EndpointSpecificity: Moderate weight trade-off, not product quality.

shineS1.g1FunctionalRelevance: Surface lubrication can improve apparent shine.
shineS1.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Oil/emollient/polyquat system gives aligned S1 signals.
shineS1.g3EndpointSpecificity: Deposition shine, not repaired split ends.

shineS3.g1FunctionalRelevance: Removing residue can support cleaner shine.
shineS3.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Strong cleanser base supports organic residue removal.
shineS3.g3EndpointSpecificity: Moderate because not a dedicated clarifier.

smoothing.g1FunctionalRelevance: Frizz/flyaways are affected by lubrication and film.
smoothing.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Polyquats plus argan oil/emollients support smoothing.

repairR1.g1FunctionalRelevance: Less friction can reduce grooming breakage.
repairR1.g3EndpointSpecificity: Reduced mechanical stress, not structural rebuilding.

repairR2.g1FunctionalRelevance: Polymer film can temporarily smooth rough damaged areas.
repairR2.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Polyquaternium-10 and -7 are plausible hair-substantive film signals.

repairR4.g1FunctionalRelevance: Named stressor is grooming breakage/frizz on dry damaged hair.
repairR4.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Lubricating oils, emollients and polyquats match a friction-reduction route.
repairR4.g3EndpointSpecificity: Capped at 2 without public finished-product breakage protocol.

organicClarification.g1FunctionalRelevance: Strong cleanser can remove sebum/styling residue.
organicClarification.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Olefin sulfonate base is relevant for organic residue removal.

mildnessPotential.g1FunctionalRelevance: Repair-positioned shampoo can be used by dry-feeling hair.
mildnessPotential.g2FormulaRelevanceAndDelivery: Co-surfactants and conditioning agents moderate feel.
mildnessPotential.g3EndpointSpecificity: Olefin sulfonate/fragrance prevent stronger mildness inference.
